notes: Primary source: NETGEAR M4250 series official datasheet (Hardware-at-a-Glance table, page 2), which lists GSM4210PX specifically as: Desktop form factor 210x40x140mm, 56 Gbps switching fabric, 8 ports PoE+ (220W budget) on 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45, 2 ports 1000/10G BASE-X SFP+, 1x external power adapter (254W PSU model APS254W), out-of-band 1G Ethernet management (rear), USB-C console (front), USB-A storage (rear). Corroborated by netgear.com product page, B&H, and Markertek listings. Caveats: (1) the exact DC barrel/proprietary connector pin dimensions for the power-adapter-to-switch connection are not published by Netgear in any consulted source, so dc-barrel is the closest available connector id but unverified pin spec; the adapter's mains-side plug is IEC C14/C13 (not modeled here since that's on the external brick, not the device's own inlet). (2) USB-C console and USB-A storage ports have no published USB speed/version, so grade is omitted per instructions. (3) SFP+ ports support both 1G and 10G; graded eth-10g as the max supported speed. (4) Desktop unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted (other M4250 SKUs in the same family are 1U/2U rackmount, but GSM4210PX/GSM4210PD are desktop-only).
